policy: Every shipped marine label has an explicit reviewed English and Norwegian Bokmål display name. Established Norwegian water names are preferred. For remaining untranslated names, use a documented Norwegian proper-name stem where available, otherwise retain the source stem, and combine it with a Norwegian water term. Constructed forms are identified in the audit; existing foreign forms supported as Norwegian usage may be retained. For politically disputed names, established Western European conventions are used conservatively and the dispute is documented.

ne:1159115399.name: Gulf of Mexico
ne:1159115399.note: Gulf of Mexico follows prevailing international and Norwegian usage; the United States renamed its federal usage to Gulf of America in 2025.

ne:1159115597.name: Persian Gulf
ne:1159115597.note: Persian Gulf follows the UN standard geographical designation; Arabian Gulf is used by some Arab states.

ne:1159115305.name: Sea of Japan
ne:1159115305.note: Sea of Japan follows prevailing international and Norwegian usage; South Korea advocates concurrent use of East Sea.
